title.name: root-mount
title.description: Six-foot root mount computed inside a disc design space 100 mm across and 40 mm tall: six bolted feet on a 36 mm ring and a 30 kN load on a top cup. The disc is only the input domain; the part is computed (SIMP topology optimisation, organic implicit skin) and solved on the real voxel FEA. Demo inputs.
